title: Give personal information (age, nationality, profession) / Gịọtara ndoro ndoro (otu, obodo, azumahia)
bridge: Na Igbo, tụọ asụsụ 'A mụrụ m' tụọ 25 afọ' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'mụrụ'), mana na English, tụọ 'I am 25 years old' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'to be'). Naanị tụọ 'A mụrụ m' tụọ obodo' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'mụrụ'), mana na English, tụọ 'I am Nigerian' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'to be'). Na azumahia, tụọ 'A mụrụ m' tụọ azumahia' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'mụrụ'), mana na English, tụọ 'I am a teacher' (na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'to be').
rule: Na afọ: 'I am [akwụkwọ] years old' (n'ime: I am 25 years old). Na obodo: 'I am [obodo]' (n'ime: I am Nigerian, I am American). Na azumahia: 'I am a/an [azumahia]' (n'ime: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Na ịkpọ: 'How old are you?' (Gịnị ka afọ gị?), 'Where are you from?' (Ebee ka ị bụrụ?), 'What do you do?' (Gịnị ka ị na-eme?) ma ọ bụ 'What is your job?'.

common_error.explanation: Na Igbo, tụọ 'A mụrụ m' tụọ 25 afọ' na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'mụrụ', mana na English, tụọ 'I am 25 years old' na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'to be'. Ọ bụghị mma nke a na-eme n'oge ụtụ.

examples.note: A na-eme ka okwụ ụtụ 'to be' na afọ.
Emeela okwụ ụtụ 'a' ma ọ bụ 'an' na azumahia.
Emeela okwụ ụtụ 'a' ma ọ bụ 'an' na azumahia.

title: Describe objects and people (basic)
bridge: N'ụkwụ Igbo, mgbe anyị na-akpọkpọ nkpọtụ na ndụ na ndị mmadụ, anyị na-egosi nkpọtụ n'okpuru nkpọtụ: 'ugbochi ọcha', 'agadi nwanyi elu'. N'English, nkpọtụ na-egosi n'elu nkpọtụ: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'. Anyị na-eme ka mkpọrọ 'to be' ga-egosi nkpọtụ ndoro (She is tall) na 'have got' ga-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Izugbe na-akpọkpọ: 1) Nkpọtụ + nkpọtụ (a big house). 2) Subject + mkpọrọ 'to be' + nkpọtụ (The house is big). 3) Subject + 'have/has got' + ndoro ndoro (She has got long hair). Nkpọtụ ndoro ndoro: big (ukwuu), small (nta), tall (elu), short (nta), beautiful (dị mma), old (ọcha), young (nwata), fast (ọnwụnwụ), slow (nwụnwụ).

concept_examples.translation: A ga-eme ka ugbochi dị ukwuu.
Ọ bụ nwanyi elu na nwanyi nta.
Ọ na-eme ka ọ nwere afo ọcha.

common_error.explanation: N'ụkwụ Igbo, nkpọtụ na-egosi n'okpuru nkpọtụ ('ugbochi ọcha'), mana n'English, nkpọtụ na-egosi n'elu nkpọtụ ('a red car'). A na-akpọkpọ n'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

examples.note: Anyị na-eme ka 'to be' ga-egosi nkpọtụ ndoro.

examples.translation: Ọ na-eme ka ọ nwere azu nri.
examples.note: Anyị na-eme ka 'have got' ga-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Nwanne m dị nwata na ọ nwere azu ndụ.

N'English, nkpọtụ na-egosi n'elu nkpọtụ: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'.
